blocks.text: Our customers often ask how to choose the best air conditioning unit for their space. The first step is to measure your space. The square footage of your property will determine the right size. An air conditioning unit that is too small for your space will force the unit to run constantly. You may experience hot spots in your home or inconsistent temperatures.

Some property owners want to choose a unit that is larger than their property needs. An air conditioning unit that is too large can cause big problems. These units require more power to run, so you’ll see an increase in your utility bills.

A larger AC unit also turns off and on more frequently, which causes uneven cooling. You may notice hot or cold spots in your home. This short cycling also prevents the unit from removing the humidity in the air. You may notice an increase in humidity, which leads to condensation and mold growth indoors. Short cycling also leads to more frequent and costly repairs.
